nodes.label: Gold Medal Badge Icon (Podium Stand)
nodes.rationale: Smooth-vector gold trophy-on-podium with a 3-tier plinth: coral #E75639 middle step, navy #13336E top step, amber #F1A41D base. Unlike the pixel sprites this uses organic circular geometry, marking it as a Wix 'color'/badge element rather than an arcade sprite.

nodes.label: Gold Badge Palette (#F1A41D / #F4B70F / #FFEC40)
nodes.rationale: Three near-identical golds carry the reward language across the whole icon set: #F1A41D in the medal badge, #F4B70F in the ribbon badge, and #FFEC40 in every pixel sprite. Because the badge gold is shifted warmer/darker, the badges read as a slightly more premium tier than the arcade sprites.
